body:
Whats the difference between using the configure widget and just adding the
searchParameters to the main instaseiarch({}) var?

On Fri, Jul 13, 2018 at 12:24 PM, Samuel Vaillant <notifications@github.com>
wrote:

> You have two possible solution to control the number of the hits. The
> first solution is to use the widget HitsPerPageSelector
> <https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hitsPerPageSelector.html>it
> will display a select that lets the user control how many hits are
> displayed. But in case you don't want to let the user choose you can use
> the Configure
> <https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/configure.html>
> widget.
>
> search.addWidget(  instantsearch.widgets.configure({    hitsPerPage: 8,
> })
> );
